Authors/company: Boswell, P. G.; Stoll, D. R.; Carr, P. W. et al.
Title: An Advanced Web-Based Simulator of High-Performance Liquid Chromatography for Educational Use
Retention model: Linear Solvent Strength (LSS) log10 k = log10 kw - S*phi
Peak-width model: Knox equation / Reduced plate height h = A*nu^(1/3) + B/nu + C*nu
Educational functionality: HIGH (interactive parameter sliders, chromatogram display, dwell volume)
Compound database: YES (~12 alkylbenzenes/pharmaceuticals calibrated on Agilent Eclipse XDB-C18)
Numerical integration: YES (numerical step tracking analyte migration along column)
Experimental validation: YES (rigorous calibration against experimental retention on C18)
Educational validation: YES (classroom deployment across multiple universities cited in JCE)
Major strengths: First robust open-source web HPLC simulator; highly accurate retention calibration; clean UI.
Major weaknesses: Zero operational fault simulation; no column aging/bubbles/leaks; no diagnostic assessment; HPLC only.
Similarity to SimuPharm: HIGH (Core HPLC physics and LSS model share identical theoretical lineage)
Potential novelty threat: HIGH on basic HPLC simulation; ZERO on fault injection and multi-instrument integration.

Authors/company: Guillarme, D.; Veuthey, J.-L. et al. (Univ. of Geneva)
Title: Practical HPLC Simulator (Excel-based Method Development Tool)
Retention model: LSS and quadratic retention modeling; column dimension scaling
Educational functionality: MEDIUM (Excel interface, steep learning curve for novices)
Compound database: YES (Custom user entry or pre-loaded test compounds)
Experimental validation: YES (calibrated against real UHPLC column data)
Educational validation: PARTIAL (used in academic workshops, limited formal pedagogical trial data)
Major strengths: Deep kinetic plot methodology; accurate UHPLC pressure limits and frictional heating modeling.
Major weaknesses: Excel desktop dependency; clunky non-web UI; no fault injection; no automated assessment.
Similarity to SimuPharm: MEDIUM (Shares fluidic/chromatographic math, but entirely different platform delivery)
Potential novelty threat: LOW (Different user experience, no web deployment, no diagnostic fault modes).

Title: Online Data Generation in Quantitative Analysis: Excel Spreadsheets and an Online HPLC Simulator Using a Jupyter Notebook on the ChemCompute Web Site
Peak-width model: Gaussian with fixed variance or simple plate height
System suitability: PARTIAL (students calculate N and Rs manually from generated data)
Educational functionality: HIGH (designed for remote pandemic lab instruction; data export for student analysis)
Compound database: YES (Small standard set for quantitative unknown determination)
Experimental validation: PARTIAL (synthetic data aligned with typical student experiments)
Educational validation: YES (published student learning evaluation in JCE)

Authors/company: Molnár, I.; Rieger, H.-J. et al. (Molnár-Institute)
Title: DryLab 4: Software for HPLC Method Development and Quality by Design (QbD)

Educational functionality: LOW (Professional industrial method development tool, not designed for novice teaching)

Title: ChromSword Auto: Automated HPLC Method Development and QSRR Modeling
